mapper.select: select b.id, b.database_id, d.name database_name, b.kind, b.external_id, b.backup_date, b.date_inferred, b.event_time, b.status from backup_record b join database_catalog d on d.id = b.database_id and d.active = true where b.backup_date between #{from} and #{to} order by b.database_id, b.kind, b.backup_date, b.event_time, b.id
select backup_date, count(*) as backup_count from backup_record where backup_date between #{from} and #{to} group by backup_date order by backup_date
select count(*) from backup_record where kind = #{kind} and external_id = #{externalId}
mapper.update: update backup_record set database_id = #{databaseId}, backup_date = #{backupDate}, date_inferred = #{dateInferred}, event_time = #{eventTime}, status = #{status}, raw_data = #{rawData}, last_seen_at = now() where kind = #{kind} and external_id = #{externalId}
mapper.insert: insert into backup_record(database_id, kind, external_id, backup_date, date_inferred, event_time, status, raw_data) values(#{databaseId}, #{kind}, #{externalId}, #{backupDate}, #{dateInferred}, #{eventTime}, #{status}, #{rawData})
